queries.sql:
SELECT v.version_id, v.version_name, v.version_type, v.is_locked, v.is_current,
             v.switchover_period, v.created_at,
             COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total_amount,
             COUNT(DISTINCT p.period) AS period_count
      FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_VERSION v
      LEFT JOIN SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.V_PLAN_COMPOSED p ON v.version_id = p.version_id AND p.module = 'revenue' AND p.fiscal_year = 2026
      GROUP BY v.version_id, v.version_name, v.version_type, v.is_locked, v.is_current, v.switchover_period, v.created_at
      ORDER BY v.version_id
